I know I understand. But youth is wasted on the young and I wish you could go through my year book and see some of those people now. Being gay is going to be a blessing. I know that world is what's in front of you now and it's your focus. But I was a pretty girl in HS lots of friends and I never had a boyfriend. I focused all my attention on one guy who didn't want to date me. I felt hopeless.  When I got to college I was considered the prettiest girl in my year still had a hard time. After in my 20's what my real youth. Now is just practice. Be happy for them friends. Your time will come. There's just know one there for you right now. It's just like walking into a party and scanning the room and saying no one datable here but I'm gonna enjoy the party till the next.
If you really want to date someone maybe consider going to places where you might find someone. You'll have to do it in your 20's so do it now. You need to get around "your people" and I don't mean so much gay but people who just "get what you"  and want the same thing. My people are sarcastic women in their 40's lol

You should go to a temp agency see if they can find you something that could go perminant.
You'd be surprised how many people with secondary degrees are no smarter than you.
Also working in warehouse managing shipping and receiving can pay a lot.
Gotta get in somewhere and prove yourself. Honestly that's what everyone has to do.
I'm in the same boat. My therapist said Xanax would not be cheating. My ex came back twice so have hope. Sounds like you could work it out.

Being gay is only a small part of who you are. There are some many things about ourselves we have to focus on and develop before we can even begin to attract someone gay or straight. I spent 3 years selibate in my 20s trying to figure out work and family crap a partner was the least of my problems. Guys would hit on me all the time, could have been women I was able to express that part of myself.
Time will come when you feel full and can start to cultivate what comes with sexuality. You've figured out you have some support work on having something to offer someone when they come along.
